prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a vibrant, retro-inspired scene featuring three young women standing in a row, each striking a playful, synchronized pose with their hands on their heads. Dress them in colorful, knee-length dresses with floral patterns—one in yellow, one in blue, and one in pink—each cinched at the waist with a pastel ribbon. Give them matching small hats perched at an angle, and have them wear white shoes with striped socks in coordinating colors. Set the scene against a bold, 1970s-style orange and yellow geometric wallpaper with large circular patterns, creating a lively and energetic backdrop. The floor should be glossy and reflective, amplifying the vividness of the scene. Use bright, even lighting to eliminate shadows and enhance the cheerful, pop-art aesthetic. The overall composition should be symmetrical and centered, with a shallow depth of field to keep the focus on the performers and their coordinated outfits, evoking the playful, polished look of a vintage music video or idol group performance.
